name: Sankey
role: Medora cowboy and rope artist, partner of Moody
bio: Sankey, half of the cowboy pair the paper called "Moody and Sankey" or "the gospel firm," left Medora in May 1884 with a Wild West outfit of cowboys, Crow Indians and broncos to perform in the east. He returned with Moody in August 1884, when the paper called them two of the best known cowboys around and unmatched with the lariat.

moments.label: Left with a Wild West show heading east
Returned to Medora from the Rocky Mountain show
